summary: Iteration 13 (backend + frontend). All 5 requested follow-ups pass. Backend: new file test_iter13_followups.py has 7 tests, all pass. Full suite: 150/150 pass (the rate-limit test did not flake this run). PATCH /users/me lifeAreaNames ['Work','Work','Health'] -> ['Work','Health'], and a GET returns the same. Onboarding POST also removes duplicates and keeps the order. Empty, unknown or non-list values return 400. UI: a skipped user sees finish-setup-banner on Settings > Profile, but not on the Appearance tab. finish-setup-link href=/onboarding?resume=1 and opens step 1. A completed user sees no banner. In onboarding step 5 the placeholder is 'e.g. Run a 5k by summer' and the suggestion is 'Exercise 3 times a week'. The counter goes from (0/5) to (5/5 — remove one to add another). At 5 habits the unselected chips are disabled, and the custom input (placeholder 'Limit reached') and the Add button are disabled. Removing a habit enables them again. The finish flow creates the goal and the 5 habits (including a custom one) in /api/v1/state. Demo login through the form reaches /today. On the Tasks Board, a Health-tagged task card shows life-area-chip-health, and it is still there after reload.

issues: Disabled habit chips (at 5/5) look the same as enabled unselected chips. Add disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
